premises.text: College students and other busy people lack time and skill to cook fresh meals, while microwave meals taste bad and are unhealthy
premises.evidence_span: We'll have limited time and ability to make food. Many of us don't know how to cook

premises.text: Cookie is a push-button robotic cooker with food-tray delivery, induction cooktop, and arm that prepares pre-portioned fresh meals
premises.evidence_span: Cookie, a push-of-a-button automated cooking device from Serenity Kitchen

premises.text: The Foodie app selects recipes, schedules cooking, sells meal kits, and lets chefs teach Cookie motions and recipes
premises.evidence_span: Foodie presents a clean, simple interface to connect a user with his or her food choices

premises.text: Meals are priced around $4 with a free app; Cookie retails at $600 or via monthly rental subscription
premises.evidence_span: A Serenity meal is typically priced at around $4 per meal. The app is free, and cookie will retail at $600

premises.text: Pre-portioned kits reduce household food waste and support healthier eating versus spoil and obesity patterns
premises.evidence_span: By pre-portioning just the right amount of healthy fresh ingredients into meal kits and reducing the amount of work required to prepare these meals

premises.text: Launch targets college students first via Indiegogo crowdfunding, then broader market
premises.evidence_span: deliver cookie and foodie first to college students and then to the broader market

value.text: Push-button fresh home-cooked meals without cooking skill or spatula work
value.evidence_span: cook a recipe meal from a recipe database without picking up a spatula

secondary_value.text: Conserve food and encourage healthier eating through pre-portioned kits
secondary_value.evidence_span: help conserve food and encourage healthier eating habits
